title: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36328v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks for verifiable code generation usually test a proof against one fixed implementation. We ask whether the same proof remains valid after a program refactoring that preserves behavior. We introduce RefactorProof, which derives 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in our pinned environment while holding the specification and evaluated proof fixed byte-for-byte. VERINA supplies reference proofs for 46 tasks, all from its basic split; the primary model-versus-reference comparisons further match on 21-25 short, non-recursive tasks. Structural refactorings expose substantial brittleness across proof sources: task-normalized structural PSR is 4.3% for the supplied references and 13.3-26.8% for the specialized provers. On the matched tasks, specialized prover proofs nevertheless have higher overall unchanged-proof survival than the supplied reference artifacts: +15.6 points for DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, +18.8

translated_title: 程序重构下大语言模型生成的证明有多稳定？可验证代码生成的压力测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36328v1 公告类型：新。摘要：可验证代码生成的基准测试通常只针对一个固定的实现来验证证明。我们提出这样一个问题：在保持程序行为不变的重构之后，同一个证明是否仍然有效？我们提出了 RefactorProof，它从在我们固定环境中可编译的 185 个 VERINA 任务中推导出 458 个经 Lean 认证的变体，同时将规范说明和被评估的证明逐字节保持不变。VERINA 为 46 个任务提供了参考证明，这些任务全部来自其基础分割集；主要的模型与参考证明的对比进一步匹配在 21-25 个简短的非递归任务上。结构性重构在各个证明来源中暴露了显著的脆弱性：任务归一化的结构 PSR（证明存活率）在提供的参考证明上为 4.3%，而在专用证明器上为 13.3%-26.8%。在匹配的任务上，专用证明器生成的证明总体上仍比提供的参考证明工件具有更高的未变更证明存活率：DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 高出 +15.6 个百分点，+18.8（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 RefactorProof 基准，通过对 185 个 VERINA 任务生成 458 个经 Lean 认证的行为保持重构变体，揭示了大语言模型生成的证明在程序结构重构下存在显著脆弱性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces RefactorProof, a benchmark deriving 458 Lean-certified variants from 185 VERINA tasks via behavior-preserving refactorings, revealing substantial brittleness of LLM-generated proofs under structural program refactoring.
